## Setup

```{r setup}
library(clinstats)
library(survival)
```

## Example: clinical characteristics

```{r characteristics}
logistic_table(
  clin_crc,
  outcome = "rfs.event",
  factors = c("sex", "age", "tnm.stage", "cms")
)
```

## Example: survival analysis

```{r survival}
cox_table(
  clin_crc,
  time = "rfs.delay",
  event = "rfs.event",
  factors = c("sex", "age", "tnm.stage", "cms")
)
```

## Example: marker evaluation

Replace `marker` with the score under evaluation. `roc_summary()` reports the
area under the curve and the optimal operating point; `survival_cutoff()`
reports the time-dependent cut point for a survival endpoint.

```{r marker}
marker <- scale(clin_crc$age)
roc_summary(marker, clin_crc$rfs.event)

survival_cutoff(
  time = clin_crc$rfs.delay,
  event = clin_crc$rfs.event,
  marker = marker,
  predict_time = 3
)
```
